question: How many traces did checkout-assistant handle on 2026-11-11 (UTC)?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(roots) FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.name = 'checkout-assistant' AND bucket >= '2026-11-11T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-11-12T00:00:00+00:00'

question: What was the estimated model cost of doc-search on 2026-10-25?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.name = 'doc-search' AND bucket >= '2026-10-25T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-10-26T00:00:00+00:00'

question: How many tokens (input plus output) did checkout-assistant use on 2026-10-21?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.name = 'checkout-assistant' AND bucket >= '2026-10-21T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-10-22T00:00:00+00:00'

question: What was the estimated model cost of all three Lumen projects together on 2026-10-23?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) FROM rollups_5m WHERE bucket >= '2026-10-23T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-10-24T00:00:00+00:00'

question: Which tool in checkout-assistant failed most often between 2026-10-27 10:00 UTC and 2026-10-29 09:00 UTC?
reference_sql: SELECT tool FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.name = 'checkout-assistant' AND tool <> '' AND bucket >= '2026-10-27T10:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-10-29T09:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(errors) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which Lumen project had the most failed spans on 2026-10-31?
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM rollups_5m r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE bucket >= '2026-10-31T00:00:00+00:00' AND bucket < '2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(errors) DESC LIMIT 1
